clips.prompt: Cinematic hand-drawn 2D Chinese anime forensic mystery. ONE LOCATION FOR EVERY SHOT: INTERIOR OF A SMALL SINGLE-LEVEL BEDROOM. A flat, level dusty gray tiled floor reaches all four walls without any change of level. Camera and both characters are INSIDE this room for the entire clip. ROOM GEOGRAPHY: a low cream floor mattress and off-white pillow against the LEFT wall; one small white enamel mug beside the mattress. Back wall: ONE rectangular window with partly raised gray venetian blind and blue overcast morning light. Against the RIGHT wall stands ONE tall narrow dark-brown freestanding wooden wardrobe, left front door has a vertical mirror, right front door plain wood, low bottom drawer, short wooden feet. Wardrobe stays CLOSED AND UNMOVED. Cream plaster walls above faded green paint, cracks and peeling paint, a simple ceiling lamp. No architectural openings visible except the back window. The single entrance is BEHIND CAMERA and never visible. Natural plausible small flat bedroom, correct perspective, continuity of walls and level floor. All furniture stays exactly placed. The reference image is ONLY for the two characters' face identities and 2D illustration style: Jian Ci, pale handsome adult black-haired male forensic pathologist, white coat over black turtleneck, black examination gloves; Lin Qian, adult short black-haired female detective, dark navy uniform jacket, black gloves. Preserve their exact faces. Replace the reference background COMPLETELY with this bedroom. Same restrained natural motion and voices as adjacent episodes: Jian Ci quiet measured baritone; Lin Qian clear, low-mid adult female Mandarin voice. Exactly TWO SHOTS: one HARD CUT at 5.00 seconds, no additional cuts or dissolves. Key faces, furniture and actions in middle 65 percent of frame, reserved margins for postproduction titles. NO visible text, subtitles or lettering anywhere. Mandarin speech only, speak ONLY exact provided sentences, no extra words. Quiet unsettling room tone, no loud music over voices. No blood or gore. SHOT 1 (0-5s): WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT OF THE BEDROOM, looking from just inside its entrance toward the back window. Show clearly that the entire floor is FLAT. Mattress and white mug on LEFT, closed wardrobe against RIGHT wall, window at BACK. No visible people. A flashlight softly sweeps bedding and mug, no objects move. Lin Qian speaks OFFSCREEN between 0.8-4.3s exactly: “封了的楼层，怎么会有床铺？” SHOT 2 (5-10s): cut to medium two-shot INSIDE the bedroom facing a solid cream-and-green side wall, Jian Ci left and Lin Qian right, both standing still. Backdrop is the SOLID ROOM WALL, without doors, windows, or architectural openings. He looks down toward the mug outside the frame, doesn't touch evidence. Jian Ci says between 5.6-9.2s exactly: “先拍照。杯子也要取样。” Lin listens. Keep full natural medium framing, not an extreme face closeup.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: Let's clear the room on the right together.

subtitles.speaker: 增援警员
subtitles.en: This room is clear. You can come in.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 封了的楼层，怎么会有床铺？
subtitles.en: Why is there bedding on a sealed floor?

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.en: Photograph it first. Sample the cup, too.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: The footprints stop at this wardrobe.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.en: There's light behind it. And a draft.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 先别进去，查它通向哪里。
subtitles.en: Hold off. Find out where it leads.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: The ringing... it's coming from inside.
